test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Raman is as __worse__ as Raju in solving mathematical problems.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. bad .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence as given contains a grammatical error in the phrase **"as worse as Raju."**
 
• The correct comparative adjective to use with "as...as" is **"bad."**
 
• Since we are making a comparison of equality, the structure to follow is **"as + adjective (positive degree) + as."**

Correct sentence: *Raman is as bad as Raju in solving mathematical problems.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative adjectives:**

 
 
• **Worse:** Used to compare two things when one is of a poorer quality, condition, or standard (e.g., "This situation is worse than before.").
 
• **Bad:** Used in the positive degree when no direct comparison is made (e.g., "This is bad.").
 
• **Worst:** Used in the superlative degree when comparing more than two things (e.g., "This is the worst day of my life.").
